Garlic Dry Chutney
By: Jayashree.T.Rao
Published: Sunday, October 2, 2016 - 3:39am

Ingredients




1 whole dry coconut
1 pod garlic
3 tablespoon chilly powder
salt to taste
1/4 teaspoon oil

Preparation

1 Cut the coconut into thin strips. 2 Roast it on a medium flame for five minutes. 3 Put it in a wide plate. 4 Roast the chilly powder with oil for a few seconds. 5 Grind all ingredients together. 6 Garlic dry chutney is ready. Store it in an airtight container. 7 Take a tip: Use chilly powder according to your taste.

About

Garlic dry chutney is a condiment that can be made and stored for many days. It is tasty and can be used for dosa, idli and bread toasts. It can be easily prepared at home with available ingredients.
